title: Medical Coding Jobs for Bioinfomatics Graduates
description:
Junior Bioinformatics Analyst\- Analyze and interpret biological and genomic datasets using bioinformatics tools and computational methods.
   

  

 Perform sequence analysis, genome annotation, variant analysis, and gene expression analysis.
   

  

 Develop and execute bioinformatics workflows and pipelines for processing biological data.
   

  

 Use programming languages such as Python, R, or Bash for data analysis and automation.
   

  

 Work with databases and tools such as NCBI, BLAST, UniProt, Ensembl, and other biological resources.
   

  

 Perform statistical analysis and data visualization to identify meaningful biological patterns.
   

  

 Maintain accurate documentation of analyses, workflows, and results.
   

  

 Collaborate with biologists, data scientists, researchers, and laboratory teams.
   

  

 Stay updated with emerging bioinformatics methods, software, and computational approaches.
   

  

**Required Skills**
 Bachelor\\'s or Master\\'s degree in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or a related field.
   

  

 Basic understanding of molecular biology, genetics, genomics, and biological data analysis.
   

  

 Knowledge of Python and/or R; familiarity with Linux/Bash is an advantage.
   

  

 Familiarity with bioinformatics databases, sequence\-analysis tools, and genomic datasets.
   

  

 Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
   

  

 Ability to learn new computational tools and biological concepts quickly.
   

  

 Contact HR SHANMUGAPRIYA:8072891550

title: Industrial Engineer
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an
 **Industrial Engineer** 
 , you will improve productivity, efficiency, quality, and cost performance across manufacturing and operational processes. You will focus on process optimization, capacity planning, labour use, line balancing, workflow improvements, Lean Manufacturing programmes, and data\-driven continuous improvement to support our goals.
   

  

 You will report to the MANUFACTURING ENGINEERING MANAGER and work onsite in Kancheepuram, Tamil Nadu, India.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Analyse manufacturing processes to identify inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and implement process optimization initiatives to improve productivity, quality, and throughput.
* Apply Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Conduct Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and Kaizen events.
* Perform capacity analysis and production planning support.
* Execute line balancing and manpower optimization studies.
* Establish labor standards using time studies and work measurement techniques.
* Monitor Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) and drive improvement actions.
* Design and improve production layouts to maximize space utilization and workflow efficiency.
* Support new product introductions (NPI) and manufacturing transfers.
* Develop standard work instructions and process documentation.
* Evaluate and implement automation opportunities.
* Collect, analyze, and interpret manufacturing data.
* Develop productivity dashboards and KPI reports.
* Track operational metrics including cycle time, utilization, quality, and cost performance.
* Provide data\-driven recommendations to management.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings in labor, materials, equipment, and processes.
* Lead projects focused on waste elimination and operational excellence.
* Support annual productivity and cost improvement targets.
* Lead cross\-functional improvement projects.
* Coordinate with production, quality, maintenance, supply chain, and engineering teams.
* Ensure projects are completed on time and meet expected business benefits.


**The Essentials – You Will Have**
* Bachelor's degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
* 8–15 years of experience in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or Operations Excellence.
* May require occasional travel to supplier or customer sites.


**The Preferred – You Might Also Have**
* Experience in high\-volume manufacturing environments.
* Time Study and Work Measurement.
* Line Balancing and Capacity Planning.
* Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma methodologies.
* Value Stream Mapping (VSM).
* Statistical Analysis and Problem Solving.
* Production Planning and Process Optimization.
* Microsoft excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets), Power BI, Minitab, AutoCAD, or equivalent tools.
* ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.) exposure preferred.
* 3D Modelling Softwares.
* APICS Certification.
* Industrial Engineering\-related certifications.


**What We Offer**
 Our benefits package includes:
   

  

* Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm.
* Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
* Employee Assistance Program.
* Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program.
* On\-demand digital course library for professional development.
* Other local benefits.


*At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.*
**FR1**

* Experience in fashion/apparel ecommerce



**Qualification** 




 Any Degree / Diploma with relevant experience in Ecommerce, Marketplace Management, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
 



**Experience** 




**1–3 years of relevant experience** 
 in Ecommerce / Marketplace Management.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Summary** 




 The AI Data Analyst will design, develop, document, and maintain data pipelines and architectures, workingclosely with IT, Data Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver artificial intelligence and machine learningsolutions. Provide technical support on selected AI systems (for example, Generative AI applications, agenticworkflows, and internal data integration tools) and participate in enterprise IT and AI projects.
 



  





**Detailed Description** 




 Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:
 


* Collaborate with IT and Data Science teams to gather technical requirements, ensuring data availability and system readiness for AI integration.
* Design, build, and optimize data pipelines (ETL/ELT) to prepare, clean, and structure datasets for machine learning models and large language models (LLMs).
* Work within Google Cloud environments to manage datasets, orchestrate data flows, and support model deployment.
* Respond to system, API, and data pipeline problems by troubleshooting data anomalies, analyzing logs, and determining the technical course of action.
* Develop and maintain technical documentation for data architectures, API integrations, and AI workflows.
* Participate in the configuration, testing, and deployment of agentic AI development and workflow orchestration platforms.



**Knowledge/Skills/Competencies** 



* Strong technical collaboration and teamwork skills within an IT environment.
* Good analytical, technical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good technical documentation skills, including mapping technical architectures, data pipelines, and system integrations.
* Good understanding of data engineering concepts, database management, and the IT software development life cycle.
* Proficient coding skills in Python (including data libraries like Pandas and NumPy) and robust SQL skills for complex database querying and data manipulation.
* Understanding of core machine learning concepts and familiarity with Generative AI tools, agentic development, and AI orchestration platforms (e.g., Flowise AI, Zapier, n8n).
* Familiarity with Google Cloud data and AI technologies, specificallyGemini, BigQuery, and Vertex AI
* Understanding of interrelations between IT infrastructure components (cloud environments, APIs, databases, data pipelines, servers, etc.).



  





**Physical Demands** 



* Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
* Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data. Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.



**Experience** 



* A minimum of three years of professional experience is required.
* 1 to 3 years of relevant experience in similar roles



**Education** 




 15 years of full time education is mandatory.
 



  





**Notes** 




 This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for anyfunction are subject to change at any time.
